title.hinglish: Apne Wi-Fi ka security type dekho

why.en: Shows whether the network you are on uses WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise (802.1X) or a shared password.
why.hinglish: Dikhata hai ki aap jis network par ho woh WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise (802.1X) use karta hai ya shared password.

expect.en: Look at the Authentication line (Windows) or SECURITY column (Linux). 'WPA2-Enterprise' or '802.1X' means RADIUS is behind it; 'WPA2-Personal' or 'WPA2' alone means a shared key. Output varies by network. On macOS use the Wi-Fi menu with Option held.
expect.hinglish: Authentication line (Windows) ya SECURITY column (Linux) dekho. 'WPA2-Enterprise' ya '802.1X' ka matlab peeche RADIUS hai; 'WPA2-Personal' ya akela 'WPA2' ka matlab shared key. Output network ke hisaab se alag hota hai. macOS par Option dabakar Wi-Fi menu use karo.

why.en: Open the downloaded .pcap and see the Access-Request, Challenge and Accept.
why.hinglish: Download kiya .pcap kholo aur Access-Request, Challenge aur Accept dekho.

expect.en: You see Access-Request (1), several Access-Challenge (11) packets, and finally Access-Accept (2) or Access-Reject (3), all on UDP 1812.
expect.hinglish: Access-Request (1), kai Access-Challenge (11) packets, aur aakhir mein Access-Accept (2) ya Access-Reject (3) dikhte hain, sab UDP 1812 par.

why.en: Shows the identity, PEAP start and TLS fragments carried inside EAP.
why.hinglish: Identity, PEAP start aur EAP ke andar carry hone wale TLS fragments dikhata hai.

expect.en: EAPOL-Start, EAP Request/Identity, EAP type 25 (PEAP) rounds, then EAP Success or Failure, followed by the 4 EAPOL-Key frames on success.
expect.hinglish: EAPOL-Start, EAP Request/Identity, EAP type 25 (PEAP) rounds, phir EAP Success ya Failure, aur success par uske baad 4 EAPOL-Key frames.

why.en: The Access-Accept carries Tunnel-Private-Group-ID, the VLAN for this user.
why.hinglish: Access-Accept mein Tunnel-Private-Group-ID hota hai, yaani is user ka VLAN.

expect.en: Open the Access-Accept and expand its attributes: you should see Tunnel-Private-Group-Id 20 and the MS-MPPE key attributes.
expect.hinglish: Access-Accept kholo aur uske attributes expand karo: Tunnel-Private-Group-Id 20 aur MS-MPPE key attributes dikhne chahiye.
